## Description {#details}

<p>An instantiation group contains a <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/structs/llvm/coverage/functionrecord">FunctionRecord</a></span> list, such that each record corresponds to a distinct instantiation of the same function.</p>


<p>Note that it's possible for a function to have more than one instantiation (consider C++ template specializations or static inline functions).</p>


<p>Definition at line 875 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/profiledata/include/llvm/profiledata/coverage/coveragemapping-h">CoverageMapping.h</a>.</p>
